Bottom left: empty iron breastplate cuirass with leather shoulder straps and short waist plates. Bottom middle: a pair of iron-plated leather gloves. Bottom right: a pair of iron-reinforced leather boots. A coordinated Wayfarer material family: dark iron, weathered oak, warm chestnut leather, restrained bronze edges and tiny moss cloth details. Rich original painterly anime-realistic high-fantasy craftsmanship, believable construction and wear, strong readable silhouettes rather than tiny ornament. No people or mannequin. Every item fully visible, wholly inside its own equal cell, with a generous clear margin on all sides. Genuine transparent PNG: background and gutters must have ZERO alpha. No background glow, fog, shadows, text, frame, labels or drawn grid. Each complete design entirely within its equal cell with a wide clear gutter and generous padding. Genuine transparent PNG alpha: exactly ZERO opacity outside the physical icon or its compact action stroke, including all gutters and inner gaps. No background card, white fog, smoke, external glow, cast shadow, scenery or visible grid. Do not add extra designs.
